## Details

### elektron-firmware-tool

C, MIT licence. Unpacks Elektron .syx firmware and repacks it as a valid file. Lists Analog Heat MKI, MKII and +FX among supported devices - currently the only Analog Heat-relevant tool we found. Forum listing: 113 stars, repo created 2026-07-22, "last commit 1 month ago" at the time of listing.

_Sources: forum mod list (mods.php?id=7), forum thread 8_

### Synthack-OS (Syntakt MAX 1.0, SY FM4 modular builder)

Several firmware mods in one build; SY FM4 included. Builder is a Windows app (a user asked for a web version). Needs the user's own OS 1.41.

_Sources: forum threads 81 and 85_

### Elektron Firmware Download List

Forum thread listing stock firmware. Not fetched in detail yet. Remember: this aggregator links to stock firmware sources but never hosts them.

_Sources: forum overview_
